name: Chipotle Fajita Veggies
desc: Copycat Chipotle fajita vegetables: green pepper and red onion seared with oregano until tender-crisp.

source.title: Fajita Veggies (Chipotle Copycat)
source.evidence: Same five ingredients in the same amounts (1/4 cup sunflower oil, 2 green peppers, 1 red onion, 1/2 tsp oregano, salt) and the same 7-minute method, nearly word for word.

ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup sunflower oil (or olive or avocado oil)
2 large green bell peppers, stemmed, cored, and sliced 1/4 inch thick
ingredients.prep: stemmed, cored, and sliced 1/4 inch thick

ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp kosher salt, or to taste

steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add the peppers, onion, oregano, and salt.
Cook, tossing occasionally, until slightly softened but still tender-crisp with a few charred edges, about 7 minutes. Serve hot.
tips: Use your widest skillet, or cook in two batches, so the vegetables sear instead of steaming.
